findings.reason: without a control the section's only measure is a scoring script whose wrong output, already measured once, reads as a verdict, and adding one changes §8's done-when.
findings.text: §8's measure is the seat's share on the fresh reference, computed by a scoring pass over two readers' labels, and nothing in the done-when plants a reference whose correct counts are known; the evidence records the failure this leaves open: `name-definition-phrases-results.json` carries `score_keying_correction`, where the first fresh pass keyed the phrase judgments by sheet id and "the phrase arm read no judgment and reported 0 of 56", corrected only because someone noticed — a planted control would have refused that reading

findings.reason: the bullet exists to make the score reproducible at a revision, and that condition cannot be checked as written.
findings.text: the bullet requires the successor "built and scored from a committed revision" with thresholds "unchanged at the revision that is scored", but no scored revision is named: the evidence names only `3a5c3d861`, which is the threshold-freeze commit, and the scoring commits after it (`65267a40f`, `5df767349`, `dd62487f2`) are not ancestors of `main` and are not cited, so a later reader cannot resolve the revision the 4-of-56 / 11-of-275 counts were produced at

findings.reason: the rule decides which check §7 re-runs and, as written, cannot select the better one in exactly the regime the section has measured.
findings.text: the verdict lets the successor replace the seat only at 80 % found and 10 % flagged, an absolute target the plan already records no arm reaching and which it exempted the seat from at §5 ("accepted … at 27 of 36 found … below the 80 % target"); so a successor that is better than the seat on both measures but still under 80 % (e.g. 60 % found and 5 % flagged against the seat's measured 57.1 % / 6.9 %) leaves the worse check running, contradicting the section's stated purpose ("the verdict on which check §7 re-runs") and the ruling it cites at line 176, "The better check is re-run over the catalog"

response_events.reason: The section is closed on a measure already taken; its close comment records that the scoring pass had no planted reference and that its first run mis-keyed the phrase judgments before correction, and that the seat's counts did not depend on that key.
